title: Parameter Smoother
text: Smooth input parameters using exponential smoothing, 3 inputs, 1 output, no direct feedthrough; {Number of parameters} sets the number of input parameters, {Smoothing mode} sets the mode to use for smoothing, {Specify smoothing factor from input port} sets the option to specify smoothing factor from input, {Smoothing factor (between 0 and 1)}, {Specify smoothing time from input port} sets the option to specify smoothing time from input, {Smoothing time constant (seconds)} sets the smoothing time in seconds, {Sample time (−1 for inherited)} sets the sample time of input parameters and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: P
ports.summary: Input parameter to smooth scalar | vector | matrix

ports.name: alpha
ports.summary: Smoothing factor scalar in the range [0, 1)

params.name: Number of parameters
params.values: Number of input parameters 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Smoothing mode
params.values: Mode to use for smoothing Smoothing factor (default) | Smoothing time

params.name: Specify smoothing factor from input port
params.values: Option to specify smoothing factor from input port off (default) | on

params.name: Smoothing factor (between 0 and 1)
params.values: Smoothing factor 0.6 (default) | scalar in the range [0, 1)

params.name: Specify smoothing time from input port
params.values: Option to specify smoothing time from input port off (default) | on

params.name: Smoothing time constant (seconds)
params.values: Smoothing time in seconds 10 (default) | nonnegative scalar

params.name: Sample time (−1 for inherited)
params.values: Sample time of input parameters -1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation
